description: Implement the API Gateway service (Fastify REST + WebSocket), authentication system (wallet-based with Ed25519 nonce verification), and all REST API endpoints including vault management endpoints. This is the central service that the frontend communicates with.
steps: Implement apps/api-gateway/src/index.ts as Fastify server with CORS, rate limiting (@fastify/rate-limit at 100 req/min per IP), JWT plugin, WebSocket support (@fastify/websocket), health check (/health), and Prometheus metrics (/metrics)
Implement apps/api-gateway/src/plugins/auth.ts with JWT verification middleware, nonce generation (stored in Redis with 5-min TTL), Ed25519 signature verification using tweetnacl
Implement apps/api-gateway/src/routes/auth.ts: POST /api/v1/auth/nonce, POST /api/v1/auth/verify (upserts user + connected_wallet, returns 7-day JWT), POST /api/v1/auth/wallet (add secondary wallet)

Implement apps/api-gateway/src/routes/traders.ts: GET /api/v1/traders/leaderboard (sort, order, page, perPage, minTrades with Redis cache), GET /api/v1/traders/search, GET /api/v1/traders/:id, POST /api/v1/traders/add

Implement apps/api-gateway/src/routes/copy.ts: GET /api/v1/copy, POST /api/v1/copy/subscribe, PATCH /api/v1/copy/:id (whitelist updatable fields), DELETE /api/v1/copy/:id, POST /api/v1/copy/:id/pause, POST /api/v1/copy/:id/resume, GET /api/v1/copy/:id/trades
Implement apps/api-gateway/src/routes/dashboard.ts: GET /api/v1/dashboard, GET /api/v1/dashboard/trades, GET /api/v1/dashboard/tokens, PUT /api/v1/dashboard/notifications

Implement apps/api-gateway/src/routes/vault.ts: POST /api/v1/vault/create, GET /api/v1/vault, GET /api/v1/vault/balance, POST /api/v1/vault/deposit, POST /api/v1/vault/withdraw, PATCH /api/v1/vault/settings (update risk params), POST /api/v1/vault/pause, POST /api/v1/vault/resume, GET /api/v1/vault/transactions

Implement apps/api-gateway/src/ws/handler.ts: WebSocket connection with JWT auth via query param, maintain Map<userId, Set<WebSocket>> for multi-tab support, handle SIGNING_REQUEST forwarding from Redis pub/sub (signing:requests:{userId}), handle SIGNING_RESPONSE from client, heartbeat PING/PONG

Implement apps/api-gateway/src/services/audit.ts: audit log writer for sensitive actions (wallet.connected, copy.subscribed, copy.settings_updated, copy.unsubscribed, vault.created, vault.deposit, vault.withdrawal, vault.paused)
Add unit tests in apps/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ covering: auth nonce flow, JWT verification, rate limiting behavior, WebSocket message routing, vault endpoint validation
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds for api-gateway and all its dependencies
Unit tests pass covering auth flow, route handlers, and WebSocket logic
All REST endpoints defined and properly typed with request/response schemas
Rate limiting configured at 100 req/min per IP
WebSocket handler supports multi-tab connections per user
Vault management endpoints are fully implemented
findings: Used fastify-plugin for auth decorator. ws package needed as explicit dependency for ESM compatibility. @fastify/websocket uses ws internally but needs WebSocket.Server mocked in vitest route tests since it requires an HTTP server. Tests use vitest resolve conditions for proper ESM ws import. 47 tests all passing.
